newsitem.title: OMAN: Britain's Prince Philip meets Oman's Sultan Qaboos.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Philip meets Oman's Sultan Qaboos.

text.p: Britain's Prince Philip met Oman's Sultan Qaboos bin Said on Friday on the latest leg of an international tour as honorary president of the Geneva-based World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), the official Omani news agency ONA said.
Earlier in the day, the Duke of Edinburgh toured Oman's coast to watch the area's sea animals which include whales and dolphins, the agency said. It did not give further details.
Prince Philip arrived in the Gulf Arab state from neighbouring United Arab Emirates on Thursday where he visited a large nature reserve.
The visit is part of a WWF tour that includes trips to Turkey, Mongolia, Japan, Russia, the United States and Canada.
